text: A traveling peddler spreads his wares on a blanket: charms, pills and curios.

outcomes.text: The peddler swears it brought him luck, and now it is yours.
A fair deal. You tuck the pills away.
Amused, he tosses you a healing pill.
He waves you off with a laugh.

text: You stumble upon an unsealed tomb. A weathered coffin rests inside, with a faint blade glow beneath its lid.

outcomes.text: The guardian spirit is long gone, and its blade is yours.
A curse lashes out as the lid lifts.
You bow to the dead and move on.

text: Your sect opens its armory to disciples who have proven themselves. You may take one reward.

outcomes.text: The steel is plain but well forged.

choices.label: Take a bundle of Healing Pills

outcomes.text: Three pills wrapped in oiled paper.

text: A reclusive alchemist beckons you into his hut, shelves heavy with rare pills.

outcomes.text: He wraps it carefully. 'Do not waste it.'
A faint chill and then a sharp mind.
You leave with nothing but an education.

text: In a forgotten grove you find a mossy shrine with an empty offering bowl.

outcomes.text: The bowl glows. A pendant of cold jade rests where your coins lay.
The shrine stays silent, but you feel lighter for the gesture.
